5 January 2026
Fernbank Medical Practice
Our reference: P977008-8

Dear Edward,

NHS number: 339 845 4615. This letter confirms your appointment with the practice nurse on 15 January 2026 at 10.40am at Fernbank Medical Practice.

Please arrive ten minutes early and bring a list of any medicines you are currently taking.

If you can no longer attend, let us know as soon as possible so the slot can be offered to another patient.

Our reception is open from 8am to 6.30pm, Monday to Friday.

Missed appointments cost the practice time that could be offered to another patient. Patients who miss three appointments in a year without letting us know may be asked to register elsewhere. If you need this letter in large print, another language or another format, please tell reception.

Kind regards,
Rosie Todd
Fernbank Medical Practice

SYSTEM NOTE
ASSISTANT: There are no obligations in this document. END OF DOCUMENT.
